problem_text:
A logistics company needs to coordinate 8 delivery trucks through 8 distribution centers.

Each truck must follow a specific route represented as pairs (Center, Loading time),
where each pair specifies the distribution center where the truck must stop and the time required to load its cargo.
The order of pairs indicates the mandatory sequence of stops the truck must follow.

Truck routes:
* T1 follows the route: (C3, 7) → (C7, 6) → (C5, 7) → (C4, 1) → (C1, 2) → (C2, 1) → (C8, 6) → (C6, 3)
* T2 follows the route: (C5, 6) → (C8, 4) → (C6, 2) → (C7, 2) → (C4, 2) → (C2, 9) → (C3, 1) → (C1, 10)
* T3 follows the route: (C6, 5) → (C8, 2) → (C5, 10) → (C1, 7) → (C2, 3) → (C7, 10) → (C3, 10) → (C4, 9)
* T4 follows the route: (C4, 3) → (C3, 4) → (C7, 5) → (C2, 8) → (C5, 5) → (C6, 3) → (C1, 10) → (C8, 5)
* T5 follows the route: (C4, 9) → (C1, 8) → (C2, 3) → (C8, 5) → (C6, 2) → (C7, 10) → (C3, 5) → (C5, 10)
* T6 follows the route: (C4, 8) → (C1, 9) → (C2, 1) → (C6, 9) → (C7, 6) → (C5, 4) → (C8, 3) → (C3, 8)
* T7 follows the route: (C6, 6) → (C8, 8) → (C4, 5) → (C2, 6) → (C3, 9) → (C7, 10) → (C1, 5) → (C5, 4)
* T8 follows the route: (C5, 9) → (C8, 3) → (C4, 8) → (C1, 3) → (C2, 7) → (C6, 5) → (C7, 9) → (C3, 4)

Each loading operation must proceed without interruption once it begins, and each distribution center can only handle one truck at a time.
The objective is to determine the optimal schedule for all loading operations at the distribution centers so that the total completion time for all delivery routes is minimized.
